settings.content: Display headings use Italiana and the script lockup uses Allura (Google Fonts stand-ins for Aquila / Autography). Body text uses Helvetica Neue. To use licensed Aquila webfonts, add the font files to assets and swap the @font-face in base.css.
Brand palette: Primary mint #C1DBD8, Secondary teal #548A83, off-white #E8EAE9, black #000000 — defined as CSS variables in base.css.
